description: Run a fresh DNS check for a configured sending domain and return DNS verification separately from sending readiness. When readyToSend is false, read readiness.reason. Receiving mail (inbox addresses and replies) is checked on receiving domains instead: see verify_receiving_domain.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: verify_sending_domain

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `verify_sending_domain` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

readyToSend.description: Whether DNS and the selected home transport are both ready for sending.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

verified.description: Whether the sending domain passed the fresh DNS verification check. Correct DNS alone does not mean the domain can send yet.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.

website.description: The Sending domain with current DNS verification, readyToSend sending readiness, SPF, DKIM, and MAIL FROM details. When readyToSend is false, read readiness.reason. inbound* fields in dnsRecords describe an older reply setup; receiving is managed with receiving domains. record returned by Sequenzy.
